name: ASM International N.V.
price_source: StockAnalysis.com (AMS:ASM) EUR 1,079 @ 2026-06-22 17:35 CET; cross-checked Yahoo/Investing.com EUR 1,066-1,080. 52-wk high EUR 1,080.50.
owner_fcf_base: Owner FCF base EUR ~899m = FY2025 reported FCF EUR 979m minus 100% SBC (est. EUR ~80m, ~2.5% of revenue; SBC null in source file, ASM historically low-single-digit % of revenue). Net cash EUR 909.6m added to enterprise value.

conservador.note: Phase1 (yrs 1-5) CAGR 10%, Phase2 declining to 5%, terminal g 2.5%. Reasonable-pessimist: WFE upcycle moderates, leading-edge ALD/epi share gains slow, capex ramp (Scottsdale) compresses near-term FCF. Not apocalyptic - still a profitable grower.

base.note: Phase1 CAGR 15%, Phase2 declining to 6%, terminal g 3.0%. Sustained leadership in gate-all-around/advanced-logic ALD & epitaxy driving above-WFE growth; 30%+ op margin and ~29% ROIC maintained.

optimista.note: Phase1 CAGR 20%, Phase2 declining to 8%, terminal g 3.5%. AI/leading-edge capex supercycle, ASM compounds ALD content per wafer through 2nm/1.4nm nodes with margin expansion.

multiple_rationale: Anchored to the ~40.5x 5y-avg forward P/E with a modest ~6% haircut to 38x for cyclical prudence (WFE end-market cyclicality, elevated 5y stat beta ~1.55, Scottsdale capex ramp, and negative Q1 2026 FCF on working-capital build). No structural franchise deterioration - haircut is cyclical, not secular. iv_multiple = forward owner-EPS EUR 21.97 (street fwd EPS ~EUR 23.6 implied by 45.7x, less SBC ~EUR 1.6/sh) x 38 = EUR 835.
structural_change: None adverse. ASM remains a structurally advantaged quality compounder: leadership in ALD/epitaxy critical for advanced-logic scaling (gate-all-around, 2nm/1.4nm), ~29% ROIC, record FY2025 margins (gross 51.8%, op 30.2%), 9th consecutive year of double-digit growth, net cash EUR ~910m. Positive structural tailwind from AI-driven leading-edge demand. Caveat: ASM discontinued quarterly bookings/backlog disclosure (Q1 2026) - mild transparency reduction. Stock at/near all-time high (+112% trailing year) on an upcycle re-rating, not depressed.
sanity_notes: Implied mcap = EUR 1,079 x 48.89M = EUR 52.75bn -> USD 61.6bn at EUR/USD 1.167, matching known ASM scale (file said USD 60.8bn) - sanity OK. Shares 48.89M verified (StockAnalysis); file used "price 1070" which is consistent. Weights tilted modestly to multiple (0.55) because ASM is a proven compounder, but DCF kept high (0.45) given genuine WFE cyclicality, high beta and capex ramp - not a low-cyclicality staple. Used fundamental beta 1.30 (not the 5y stat 1.55, which overstates the cost of equity for a net-cash quality grower); at beta 1.55 WACC ~10.6% and DCF IVs ~10-12% lower. Reconciled IV EUR 736 sits ~32% BELOW the EUR 1,079 price (IV/price ~0.68, well within the 30-300% magnitude band) - conclusion: high-quality business but currently EXPENSIVE at the top of an AI upcycle; price embeds aggressive forward EPS (~EUR 23.6, ~+60% on FY2025's ~EUR 14.8) and a ~45x multiple. Margin of safety is negative at today's price.
